Success may feel different than you think. Kevin explains how.

Kevin Trudeau says the journey is the reward, and that enjoying it is the real definition of being successful.

He describes waking up and feeling in your whole body: I love being me, and I love my life. In his view, that person is the most successful on the planet, whatever they have and whatever their finances, relationships or health look like.

Kevin says the attitude has to come first.

Do you wake up loving being you?
